theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cluster_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (s : Finset (Euclidean N)) (d : ℝ), 2 ≤ s.card → 0 < d → (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' → d ≤ ‖y - y'‖) → (∃ y ∈ s, ∃ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' ∧ ‖y - y'‖ ≤ d) → ∃ (Z : Finset (Euclidean N)) (S : ℝ), Z ⊆ s ∧ Z.card < s.card ∧ 0 ≤ S ∧ S ≤ (10 * (s.card : ℝ)) ^ s.card * d ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∃ z ∈ Z, ‖y - z‖ ≤ S) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, z ≠ z' → 2 * d + 4 * S ≤ ‖z - z'‖
